description: This file defines the UnmappedOutboundSignal class, which represents an outbound signal object that has not yet been mapped to an external message. It includes methods for creating instances from JSON data, converting to JSON, and standard object methods. The class is part of the org.eclipse.ditto.services.models.connectivity package.

classes.name: UnmappedOutboundSignal
classes.description: An immutable class representing an outbound signal before it is mapped to an external message. Provides functionality to instantiate from JSON, serialize to JSON, and access source and target information.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Static factory method to create an UnmappedOutboundSignal instance from a JSON object, parsing the source signal and targets based on provided mapping strategies.

methods.name: getSource
methods.description: Returns the source signal associated with this outbound signal.

methods.name: getTargets
methods.description: Returns the list of targets for this outbound signal.

methods.name: toJson
methods.description: Serializes this object into a JSON representation, applying schema version and predicate filtering.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Overrides Object.equals to compare UnmappedOutboundSignal instances based on source and targets.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Overrides Object.hashCode to generate hash based on source and targets.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Overrides Object.toString to provide a string representation of the object.
